description: Newsletter and mailing list manager: subscribers, lists, templates, and campaigns (create, test, schedule, send) on a self-hosted listmonk instance.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: The access token of a listmonk API user, created under Admin -> Users -> New with the user type API. The provider acts with that user's role and list permissions.

extraFields.label: Instance Base URL
extraFields.description: The root URL of your listmonk instance, the same origin that serves the /admin dashboard. A trailing /api or /admin is stripped.

extraFields.label: API Username
extraFields.description: The username of the listmonk API user the token belongs to.

actions.name: blocklist_subscribers
actions.description: Blocklist one or more listmonk subscribers. Blocklisted subscribers are unsubscribed from every list and never receive campaigns.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for blocklisting subscribers.

actions.name: cancel_campaign
actions.description: Cancel a running or paused campaign permanently. A cancelled campaign cannot be resumed.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for cancelling one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: create_campaign
actions.description: Create a listmonk campaign as a draft. Nothing is sent: use send_campaign_test to preview it by email, then schedule_campaign or start_campaign to send it. Setting sendAt here only stores the time; the campaign is not scheduled until schedule_campaign runs.

subject.description: The email subject. May contain listmonk template expressions.

listIds.description: The list IDs to send the campaign to.

fromEmail.description: The From header, for example "Chicago Aggies <news@example.org>". Defaults to the instance setting.

body.description: The campaign body in the chosen contentType.

altbody.description: An optional plain-text alternative body for HTML and richtext campaigns.

templateId.description: The campaign template ID. Defaults to the instance default template.

sendAt.description: When to send, as an ISO-8601 timestamp WITH a timezone offset, for example 2026-10-01T09:00:00+02:00 or 2026-10-01T07:00:00Z. Must be in the future. listmonk stores the absolute instant; the dashboard displays it in the listmonk server's timezone, so always state the offset explicitly.

messenger.description: The messenger to send through. Defaults to email.

headers.description: Extra SMTP headers, each an object with one header name and value.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: create_list
actions.description: Create a listmonk mailing list.

type.description: public lists appear on the public subscription form; private lists do not.

optin.description: single subscribes immediately; double sends a confirmation email.

status.description: The list status. Defaults to active.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating one list.

list.description: A listmonk list with id, uuid, name, type, optin, status, tags, description, subscriber_count, and timestamps.

actions.name: create_subscriber
actions.description: Create a listmonk subscriber and optionally subscribe it to lists. Double opt-in lists send a confirmation email unless preconfirmSubscriptions is true.

status.description: The subscriber status. Defaults to enabled.

listIds.description: List IDs to subscribe the subscriber to.

attribs.description: Arbitrary JSON attributes stored on the subscriber and available in templates, for example {"city": "Bengaluru"}.

preconfirmSubscriptions.description: Mark the subscriptions as confirmed so no opt-in email is sent for double opt-in lists.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating one subscriber.

subscriber.description: A listmonk subscriber with id, uuid, email, name, attribs, status, lists (with subscription_status), created_at, and updated_at.

actions.name: delete_campaign
actions.description: Permanently delete one listmonk campaign.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for deleting one campaign.

actions.name: delete_subscriber
actions.description: Permanently delete one listmonk subscriber and its subscriptions.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for deleting one subscriber.

actions.name: get_campaign
actions.description: Fetch one listmonk campaign with its status, schedule, target lists, body, and delivery counters.

noBody.description: Omit the campaign body from the response.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: get_campaign_analytics
actions.description: Fetch campaign analytics over a date range: daily view, click, or bounce counts, or per-link click counts (type links).

campaignIds.description: The campaign IDs to report on.

from.description: The range start, as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

to.description: The range end, as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching campaign analytics.

type.description: The analytics type that was requested.

results.description: The analytics rows returned by listmonk.

actions.name: get_campaign_preview
actions.description: Render the campaign body inside its template and return the HTML preview, exactly as recipients would see it.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for previewing one campaign.

actions.name: get_list
actions.description: Fetch one listmonk list.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching one list.

list.description: A listmonk list with id, uuid, name, type, optin, status, tags, description, subscriber_count, and timestamps.

actions.name: get_profile
actions.description: Fetch the listmonk user profile of the connected API user, including its role and permissions.

inputSchema.description: No input is required for this action.

actions.name: get_running_campaign_stats
actions.description: Fetch live delivery stats (sent, to_send, rate, started_at) for currently running campaigns, optionally narrowed to specific campaign IDs.

campaignIds.description: Only return stats for these campaign IDs.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching running campaign stats.

actions.name: get_subscriber
actions.description: Fetch one listmonk subscriber with attributes and list subscriptions.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching one subscriber.

subscriber.description: A listmonk subscriber with id, uuid, email, name, attribs, status, lists (with subscription_status), created_at, and updated_at.

actions.name: get_template
actions.description: Fetch one listmonk template including its body.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching one template.

template.description: A listmonk template with id, name, type, subject, body, is_default, and timestamps.

actions.name: list_campaigns
actions.description: List listmonk campaigns, optionally filtered by a name/subject search, statuses, or tags, with paging.

query.description: Full-text and substring search over campaign name and subject.

statuses.description: Only campaigns in any of these statuses.

tags.description: Only campaigns carrying any of these tags.

perPage.description: Results per page. Defaults to the listmonk default (20).

all.description: Return every matching record in one page (per_page=all). Overrides page and perPage.

noBody.description: Omit campaign bodies from the response. Defaults to true.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing campaigns.

items.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

perPage.description: The page size used by listmonk (0 when all results were requested).

actions.name: list_lists
actions.description: List listmonk mailing lists with subscriber counts, optionally filtered by name, status, or tags.

tags.description: Only lists carrying any of these tags.

perPage.description: Results per page. Defaults to the listmonk default (20).

all.description: Return every matching record in one page (per_page=all). Overrides page and perPage.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing lists.

items.description: A listmonk list with id, uuid, name, type, optin, status, tags, description, subscriber_count, and timestamps.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

perPage.description: The page size used by listmonk (0 when all results were requested).

actions.name: list_subscribers
actions.description: Query listmonk subscribers, optionally filtered by list membership and an SQL expression over the subscribers table, with paging.

query.description: An SQL WHERE expression over the subscribers table, for example subscribers.email LIKE '%@example.com' or subscribers.attribs->>'city' = 'Chicago'. The API user's role needs the subscribers:sql_query permission whenever this is set.

listIds.description: Only subscribers in any of these list IDs.

subscriptionStatus.description: Filter by subscription status on the given listIds.

perPage.description: Results per page. Defaults to the listmonk default (20).

all.description: Return every matching record in one page (per_page=all). Overrides page and perPage.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for querying subscribers.

items.description: A listmonk subscriber with id, uuid, email, name, attribs, status, lists (with subscription_status), created_at, and updated_at.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

perPage.description: The page size used by listmonk (0 when all results were requested).

actions.name: list_templates
actions.description: List listmonk templates (campaign, visual campaign, and transactional) to pick a templateId for campaigns.

noBody.description: Omit template bodies from the response. Defaults to true.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing templates.

items.description: A listmonk template with id, name, type, subject, body, is_default, and timestamps.

actions.name: manage_subscriber_lists
actions.description: Add subscribers to lists, remove them from lists, or mark their subscriptions as unsubscribed. status is required when action is add.

status.description: The subscription status to set when action is add.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for changing list memberships.

actions.name: pause_campaign
actions.description: Pause a running campaign. It can be resumed later with start_campaign. Only running campaigns can be paused.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for pausing one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: schedule_campaign
actions.description: Schedule a draft or paused campaign to be sent automatically at sendAt: stores sendAt on the campaign, then changes its status to scheduled. A campaign that is already scheduled is simply moved to the new time. SENDS EMAIL TO ALL SUBSCRIBERS OF THE TARGET LISTS - confirm with the user before executing.

sendAt.description: When to send, as an ISO-8601 timestamp WITH a timezone offset, for example 2026-10-01T09:00:00+02:00 or 2026-10-01T07:00:00Z. Must be in the future. listmonk stores the absolute instant; the dashboard displays it in the listmonk server's timezone, so always state the offset explicitly.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for scheduling one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: send_campaign_test
actions.description: Send the campaign as it is currently saved to specific test addresses only (not to the lists). Each address must already exist as a subscriber in listmonk.

emails.description: The subscriber email addresses to send the test to.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for sending one test campaign.

sent.description: Whether listmonk queued the test messages.

actions.name: start_campaign
actions.description: Start sending a draft or paused campaign immediately (status running); a paused campaign resumes where it stopped. SENDS EMAIL TO ALL SUBSCRIBERS OF THE TARGET LISTS - confirm with the user before executing.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for starting one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: unschedule_campaign
actions.description: Unschedule a scheduled campaign by moving it back to draft, so it is not sent at its sendAt. The stored sendAt is kept; only scheduled campaigns can be unscheduled.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for unscheduling one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: update_campaign
actions.description: Update a draft, scheduled, or paused listmonk campaign. Only the provided fields change; target lists and attachments are preserved unless listIds is given. Pass sendAt null to clear a stored send time; listmonk rejects every update while the stored send time is in the past.

listIds.description: The complete set of target list IDs.

tags.description: The complete set of tags; replaces existing tags.

anyOf.description: When to send, as an ISO-8601 timestamp WITH a timezone offset, for example 2026-10-01T09:00:00+02:00 or 2026-10-01T07:00:00Z. Must be in the future. listmonk stores the absolute instant; the dashboard displays it in the listmonk server's timezone, so always state the offset explicitly.

sendAt.description: A new send time as an ISO-8601 timestamp with a timezone offset, or null to clear the stored send time.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for updating one campaign.

campaign.description: A listmonk campaign with id, uuid, name, subject, from_email, status, type, content_type, body, send_at, lists, tags, template_id, and the sent/to_send/views/clicks/bounces counters.

actions.name: update_list
actions.description: Update one listmonk list. Only the provided fields change; the current name and tags are preserved when omitted.

tags.description: The complete set of tags; replaces existing tags.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for updating one list.

list.description: A listmonk list with id, uuid, name, type, optin, status, tags, description, subscriber_count, and timestamps.

actions.name: update_subscriber
actions.description: Update one listmonk subscriber. Only the provided fields change: the current subscriber is read first and merged, so omitted fields and list subscriptions are preserved. Passing listIds replaces the subscriber's list subscriptions; attribs replaces all attributes. Unless preconfirmSubscriptions is true, an instance with opt-in confirmations enabled emails the subscriber again for every double opt-in list that is still unconfirmed.

listIds.description: The complete set of list IDs the subscriber should belong to.

attribs.description: Arbitrary JSON attributes stored on the subscriber and available in templates, for example {"city": "Bengaluru"}.

preconfirmSubscriptions.description: Mark newly added subscriptions as confirmed without an opt-in email.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for updating one subscriber.

subscriber.description: A listmonk subscriber with id, uuid, email, name, attribs, status, lists (with subscription_status), created_at, and updated_at.
